description: Séance: status. WHEN: Séance status — phase from the clock (scheduled|nominating|voting|closed), the windows, nominations, live standings during voting (votes desc, ties by earliest nomination then tombstone id), and the winner once closed. Zero votes means NO winner. Read-only, 0 credits, no key needed. Omit seance_id for the latest séance (Worker-port convenience; the core required it). Example: seance_status {}

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.

seance_id.description: Séance id. Optional: defaults to the latest séance.

name: seance_status
title: Séance: status + standings
